subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Technology has ______ (supreme) importance in the life of modern men.
solution:
The correct answer is '**paramount**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Supreme**' means the highest in rank or authority. (श्रेष्ठ or सर्वोच्च)

 
 
• **Example**: The **supreme **court is the highest court of the land.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym of '**supreme**' in this context is '**paramount**'. '**Paramount**' means more important than anything else; supreme. (सर्वप्रथम or सर्वाधिक)
 
 
• **Example**: Maintaining their health is of **paramount **importance for old people.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, '**magnanimous**', means generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person. (उदार)
 
• Option 3, '**miraculous**', means occurring through divine or supernatural intervention, or manifesting such power. (चमत्कारी)
 
• Option 4, '**profuse**', means (especially of something offered or discharged) exuberantly plentiful; abundant. (प्रचुर)
